main_measure.name: in-stretch minus all-bar mean next-bar return (before costs)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if difference > 0 with t >= 2.0; reject if difference <= 0 or t <= -2.0; inconclusive if t is between -2.0 and 2.0

supporting_check.name: in-stretch up-day share minus all-bar up-day share

decided_by: Inconclusive: the in-stretch mean exceeds the all-bar mean, but the t-statistic lies between -2.0 and 2.0.
reading: In-stretch bars are the bars with forecast > 0. Distinct up-cross stretches are contiguous runs of forecast > 0 within each window, counting a run that is already on at a window's first row. Every bar's next-bar return is used, since h = 1 makes every bar non-overlapping. The test is Welch's t of in-stretch returns against all-bar returns. An up day is a next-bar return > 0.
